item.title: Regional power auction clears at record price
item.description: Capacity auction for the 2027 delivery year cleared at 94 dollars per megawatt day, double last year's price, as two retirements tightened the supply cushion.

item.title: Transit agency expands overnight service
item.description: Starting next month, six bus corridors will run every thirty minutes around the clock, funded by a two year pilot the board approved unanimously.

item.title: Story published with a relative link
item.description: The link element carries a site-relative path, which locally-imported feeds cannot resolve against the publisher host.
